messages.author: 405f4e6b33fa219f
messages.subject: Error reading in data to be fit (using wcs_sql)
parts:
Hi there, 

I've only just started using hBayesdm, and I'm attempting to read in my data which has been saved in a tab delimited text file, and is arranged according to how it is specified in the ?wcs_sql documentation. 
Unfortunately, I keep getting this error everytime I try and run the modelling code:

 In mean.default(parVals[[x]][, i]) :
  argument is not numeric or logical: returning N



It seems to think the numerical values in the rows are non-numeric, and hence keeps substituting the values for NA. As a result, the model refuses to run, and I also get this error repeatedly for every data point:

Chain 1: Rejecting initial value:
Chain 1:   Error evaluating the log probability at the initial value.
Chain 1: Exception: multinomial_lpmf: Probabilites parameter is not a valid simplex. sum(Probabilites parameter) = nan, but should be 1  (in 'model3a9012f92ae3_wcs_sql' at line 71)


I don't have this problem when I try the example data downloaded from the hBayesdm tutorial website. I have tried to copy the example format exactly in my own text file, but it's still not working.

I believe I have used the wcs_sql function properly as well, since the code is reading the file and the headers just fine. It's just that it does not recognise my values as logical. Here is what I wrote in R:


output1<-wcs_sql(data="mypath/wcst_data.txt", niter=2000, nwarmup=1000, nchain=4, ncore=1)

I have attached my data file here for reference. I think I have formatted it correctly but there must be a mistake somewhere since I keep getting this error.

Thank you so much for your kind help/advice!

Best Wishes,
Aleya
